title: Concept: Possible a InfluxDB connection URL with inline credentials assigned to INFLUXDB_URL in source
description: a InfluxDB connection URL with inline credentials assigned to INFLUXDB_URL embeds datastore or broker credentials in a URL. Every reader, log shipper and backup that touches the file inherits the account, so rotation plus environment injection is the only durable fix.
applicability: Source, .env files, compose files and CI configuration that may embed a InfluxDB connection URL with inline credentials assigned to INFLUXDB_URL.
risk: Authenticated access to the datastore or broker behind the URL; HIGH severity.
